mapper.select: select distinct tenant_id from build_ownership where not is_deleted

select b.build_id as build, b.environment_id as environment from build_ownership b left join asset_build_scope s on s.tenant_id = b.tenant_id and s.build_id = b.build_id and not s.is_deleted where not b.is_deleted and b.tenant_id = #{tenant} and s.build_id is null
mapper.insert: insert into asset_build_scope(tenant_id, build_id, environment_id, repository, branch_name) values (#{tenant}, #{build}, #{target.environmentId}, #{target.repository}, #{target.branchName}) on conflict do nothing
mapper.select: select distinct repository, environment_id, branch_name from asset_build_scope where not is_deleted and tenant_id = #{tenant}
select repository, environment_id, branch_name from asset_build_scope where not is_deleted and tenant_id = #{tenant} and build_id = #{build}
mapper.sql: select indexed from asset_build_scope where not is_deleted and tenant_id = #{tenant} and build_id = #{build}
mapper.update: update asset_build_scope set indexed = true where not is_deleted and tenant_id = #{tenant} and build_id = #{build}
mapper.sql: a.asset_id, a.owner_id, b.repository, a.environment_id, b.branch_name, a.kind, m.node_id, a.dimension_name, m.query_name, m.selector, (a.owner_id = u.id or g.user_id is not null) as granted, m.build_id as build

from deployed_asset a join asset_build_member m on m.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and m.asset_id = a.asset_id and not m.is_deleted join asset_build_scope b on b.tenant_id = m.tenant_id and b.build_id = m.build_id and not b.is_deleted join platform_user u on u.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and u.id = #{reader} and not u.is_deleted left join asset_user_grant g on g.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and g.asset_id = a.asset_id and g.user_id = u.id and not g.is_deleted
mapper.select:
select , null::text as environment_name
where not a.is_deleted and a.tenant_id = #{tenant} and m.build_id = #{build} order by m.node_id, a.dimension_name
mapper.insert: insert into asset_catalog_observation(tenant_id, environment_id, build_id, scan_sequence) values (#{tenant}, #{environment}, #{build}, #{sequence}) on conflict (tenant_id, environment_id) do update set build_id = excluded.build_id, scan_sequence = excluded.scan_sequence, is_deleted = false where asset_catalog_observation.scan_sequence < excluded.scan_sequence
mapper.sql: join asset_catalog_observation o on o.tenant_id = b.tenant_id and o.environment_id = b.environment_id and o.build_id = b.build_id and not o.is_deleted
mapper.select:
select , coalesce(e.name, a.environment_id::text) as environment_name
left join execution_environment e on e.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and e.environment_id = a.environment_id and not e.is_deleted where not a.is_deleted and a.tenant_id = #{tenant} order by environment_name, a.environment_id, m.node_id, a.dimension_name

select , null::text as environment_name
where not a.is_deleted and a.tenant_id = #{tenant} and a.asset_id = #{asset}

select exists(select from platform_user u join platform_tenant t using (tenant_id) where not u.is_deleted and not t.is_deleted and u.tenant_id = #{tenant} and u.id = #{reader} and u.id <> t.manager_id)

select u.id, u.username from platform_user u join platform_tenant t using (tenant_id) where not u.is_deleted and not t.is_deleted and u.tenant_id = #{tenant} and u.id <> t.manager_id order by u.username
mapper.insert: insert into asset_user_grant(tenant_id, user_id, asset_id) values (#{tenant}, #{reader}, #{asset}) on conflict (tenant_id, user_id, asset_id) do update set is_deleted = false where asset_user_grant.is_deleted
